sign_in.title: Sign in to the CMS
sign_in.subtitle: The content behind franciscosolis.cl. Sign in with the account that was granted access — no passwords involved.
sign_in.email_hint: We email you a single-use link that signs you in.
sign_in.provider_unavailable: This provider is not configured on this deployment.
sign_in.no_password: There is no password to forget — every sign-in is a fresh, single-use grant.
sign_in.staff_only: The CMS is only open to accounts with an editor role.
sign_in.sent_subtitle: If {{email}} may sign in to the CMS, the link is on its way.
sign_in.sent_expiry: It expires in about {{minutes}} minutes and works once.
sign_in.sent_note: Open the link in this browser so the sign-in can finish where it started. You can close this tab afterwards.

callback.title: Signing you in
callback.subtitle: Exchanging the authorization code for your CMS session.
callback.error_subtitle: The link may have already been used, or it expired before it was opened.

no_access.title: No access to the CMS
no_access.subtitle: This account is signed in, but it holds no role in the CMS.
no_access.subtitle_email: {{email}} is signed in, but it holds no role in the CMS.
no_access.alert_body: Access is granted per application from the auth console. Once a role is granted, sign in again so a fresh token carries it.

dashboard.title: Content
dashboard.subtitle: You are signed in to the CMS. This is the account the API sees on every write, and what it is currently allowed to do.
dashboard.session_description: The session every request from this tab travels with.
dashboard.access_description: The roles and permissions this account holds in the CMS.
dashboard.access_note: Roles and permissions are minted into the access token, so a change can take up to the token's lifetime to show here. The API is always the authority.
dashboard.collections_description: What this CMS manages. The service is the one that decides the list.
dashboard.collections_empty: This CMS manages no collections yet.
dashboard.editing_soon: Editing screens are not part of this interface yet — this release covers signing in and the access checks around it.

common.forbidden_body: This section needs a permission your account does not hold.

errors.network: The service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.missing-code: This address is missing the authorization code the provider should have sent.
errors.missing-transaction: This browser has no record of the sign-in that started this link. Start again from the CMS sign-in page.
errors.state-mismatch: The sign-in could not be verified. Start again from the CMS sign-in page.
